title: R7 learning re-entry: produce instinctSummary (top-k lessons by file/keyword overlap with the selected task) and inject it where builder/scout/triage personas already instruct agents to read it — today the variable has ZERO producers in Go
summary: Gap G6: ~650 lesson YAMLs under .evolve/instincts/lessons/, .evolve/genes/ empty, and `instinctSummary` referenced by three personas has no producer (only a prose mention in bedrock.go:111). Retro output re-enters the pipeline through an optional grep competing with a ~20-turn budget. Evidence: Reflexion episodic memory (2303.11366); L1541b 'the same lesson nine cycles later'.
root_cause: The learning loop is write-only: lessons are rendered, never selected and injected.
fix: Deterministic selector: score lessons by overlap of their files[]/keywords with the top_n item's files[] and title; inject top-k (policy-bounded) as instinctSummary into the build/tdd/scout prompts; record which lessons were injected in the cycle dossier for the dashboard.
acceptance: A cycle whose top_n touches go/internal/core/repair_eligibility.go receives lessons L1596b/L1603a in its build prompt (fixture).
Injected lesson ids appear in the dossier.
Selector is pure and unit-tested; k and score threshold come from policy.
